title: Reset Early, Reset Often, Eliminate Models
abstract: arXiv:2610.18204v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Connection-tableau provers typically construct closed tableaux by backtracking search. This gives lightweight proof procedures, but their low-memory search state leaves little derived information to reuse after a failed attempt. SATCoP addresses this by retaining grounded tableau clauses in an incremental SAT solver, allowing the prover to refute the problem once the accumulated ground clauses become propositionally unsatisfiable. We introduce SATResetCoP, which relies more directly on this persistent SAT state by not backtracking on unproductive tableaux and instead starting new ones to generate further ground clauses for the SAT solver. On TPTP, SATResetCoP improves over our leanCoP-style baseline by 54% and our SATCoP-style baseline by 18%. translated_title: 早重置、常重置、消除模型
translated_abstract: 连接表证明器通常通过回溯搜索来构造封闭的表（tableaux）。这种方式提供了轻量级的证明过程，但其低内存占用的搜索状态在一次失败的尝试之后几乎没有可重用的推导信息。SATCoP通过在增量式SAT求解器中保留基例化（grounded）的表子句来解决这个问题，使得一旦累积的基例子句在命题层面不可满足，证明器就能反驳该问题。我们提出了SATResetCoP，它更直接地依赖这种持久的SAT状态：不对无成效的表进行回溯，而是放弃它们并重新开始新的表，以便为SAT求解器生成更多的基例子句。在TPTP上，SATResetCoP相比我们的leanCoP风格基线提升了54%，相比我们的SATCoP风格基线提升了18%。在bushy MPTP2078基准测试中，它解决了616个问题，比leanCoP风格基线提升49%，比SATCoP风格基线提升12%。这些结果表明……
tldr: 提出SATResetCoP，放弃对无成效连接表的回溯，转而频繁重置并开启新表，持续为增量式SAT求解器积累基例子句，在TPTP上较基线提升54%，在MPTP2078基准上提升49%。
en_tdlr: SATResetCoP abandons backtracking on unproductive connection tableaux, instead frequently resetting to start fresh tableaux and accumulate more ground clauses for an incremental SAT solver, achieving 54% improvement on TPTP and 49% on MPTP2078 over baselines.
